svg.text: Three graphs, one key per cell: precision-against-oracle and recall, never pooled
One colour per tool; the same repo, commit, answer key, matcher and poison check (ADR-101).
The tools' numbers are at our grain (C-94, C-95) and host-run (C-96). Hover a marker for its fraction; the grey line spans the three.
recall, of in-repo oracle pairs at the cell's roots

svg.text: Read across a row, never down a column: each cell's recall is over its own roots or resolved sites (C-62), and a precision is a lower bound (contradictions mostly triage to
the oracle's grain, A-8). Every Hobbes marker on the precision axis sits at 100% except fmt (6,901/6,901, a 100.0% lower bound; strict 6,901/6,928, 99.6%), quic-go
(3,766/3,781, a 99.6% lower bound), triaged in its record. The tools' contradictions are a lower bound on their precision exactly as ours is on ours; a 40-row random sample
read by hand found tool-wrong 39, oracle-grain 1 after the converters' Java annotation-line defect (C-94) was repaired and the Java cells regraded, and the C++ cells' 60-row
sample tool-wrong 56, oracle-grain 4 after converter@4 read a spaced #define and a split declaration head. On repowise-bench's draws the key is ours, at site grain — not
comparable with their published table; syft is absent because RTA over it is killed by the kernel on this box.
Rendered from docs/oracle/cells/ by bench/oracle/report/render.py (ADR-102); the numbers are in tables.md.
